t: This is Paddington station, the London terminus of the Great Western Railway since 1838. The main line station you see now opened in 1854, and it was designed by Isambard Kingdom Brunel, the Great Western's first engineer, who also built its London to Bristol main line. Brunel is counted among the greatest figures of the Industrial Revolution. Paddington is also very busy. In the year to March 2025 it was the third busiest station in Britain, after Liverpool Street and Waterloo, with nearly seventy million entries and exits. The miniature painter Henry Edridge was born here, too.
